holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: FDA action resulted in FIRs registered against officials of Blinkit and Zomato Hyperpure concerning expired food products.
Flipkart prepared to enter food delivery to challenge Zomato with a planned launch called 'Eat-in by Minutes'.
June 2026 quarter sales reached ₹20,211 crore with operating profit of ₹594 crore and net profit of ₹92 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 6.56% of the portfolio, Zomato is the fund's largest single holding and generated an estimated 3-month contribution of +0.76% via an 11.59% return.

watch.text: Earnings conference call and board meeting scheduled for October 21, 2026 to approve Q2 FY26 financial results.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank reported September 2026 net profit of ₹17,389 crore on revenue of ₹55,992 crore.
The bank's CASA ratio declined 340 bps to 36.1% as foreign currency non-resident deposits surged.

expected.text: Brokerages projected an earnings beat for Q2, leading Goldman Sachs to estimate a 45% upside and Emkay setting a ₹1,785 target price.

seeing.text: Standalone profit reached ₹14,843 crore and consolidated profit reached ₹16,333 crore, leading brokerages to reiterate bullish stances despite the stock slipping 1% post-results.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank represents 5.81% of fund assets and was a top detractor over 3 months, posting a -5.42% return that deducted an estimated 0.315% from portfolio return.

watch.text: Trends in CASA ratio and funding mix following the 340 bps drop to 36.1%.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 quarter net profit rose to ₹6,367 crore on revenue of ₹24,546 crore, with gross NPA at 1.06% and net NPA at 0.42%.
The company's gold loan portfolio doubled, followed by the termination of a scheme.
Prashant Verma was re-appointed Chief Information Security Officer for three years starting February 1, 2027.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.53% weight, Bajaj Finance was the second-largest drag over 3 months, falling -10.02% and costing the portfolio an estimated -0.554%.

watch.text: Impact of terminating the gold loan scheme following rapid doubling of the book.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported September 2026 net profit of ₹21,537 crore on revenue of ₹95,132 crore.
Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will cease his role on December 31, 2026, while Lily Vadera was reappointed as independent director.
Private bank inoperative Jan Dhan accounts saw an increase led by HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank.

expected.text: Brokerages flagged net interest margin pressure ahead of results and trimmed target prices.

seeing.text: The stock fell 2% post-earnings on margin pressure, even as brokerages like Bernstein maintained upside projections of up to 58%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 4.61% of the fund, HDFC Bank detracted an estimated 0.389% over 3 months as its share price dropped -8.44%.

watch.text: Management roadmap presentation by Bagchi and the executive transition when Kaizad Bharucha steps down on December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Titan Company Ltd

what_changed.text: Titan reported 25% YoY growth across consumer businesses in its Q2 FY27 update, adding 78 retail stores to reach 3,758 stores.
The company fully redeemed two commercial paper tranches of ₹825 crore and ₹1,000 crore in October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.94% portfolio weight in Consumer Discretionary, Titan declined -4.72% over 3 months, offsetting parts of the fund's IT gains.

watch.text: Board meeting to consider and approve Q2 results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

holdings.name: Coforge Ltd

what_changed.text: Coforge launched an intent engineering framework for enterprise AI agents and expanded its Kraków AI engineering center toward 660 personnel by 2027.
HDFC Mutual Fund reduced its stake in Coforge to 4.30% on October 6, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 3.77% of the fund, Coforge was the top positive contributor over 3 months, gaining 27.7% and adding an estimated +1.044% to returns.

watch.text: Earnings conference call on October 23, 2026 for Q2 and H1 FY27 results.

holdings.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Dixon signed a 60/40 joint venture agreement with Gemtek to manufacture optical transceivers via Dixon Electroconnect by February 2027.
Its subsidiary signed an intellectual property licensing agreement with Aviat Networks.
CRISIL assigned the company an ESG Rating of 61 and Core ESG of 67.

holdings.why_it_matters: Dixon was the fund's largest negative contributor over 3 months (-0.616%), dropping -17.06% at a 3.61% portfolio weight.

watch.text: Execution of the Gemtek joint venture targeted for completion by February 3, 2027.

holdings.name: Info Edge (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Info Edge reported a 12.8% increase in Q2 FY27 billings, though Shiksha dragged performance.
The board approved ₹200 crore total investments across two wholly owned subsidiaries, SISL and SIHL (₹100 crore each).

holdings.why_it_matters: Info Edge carries a 3.59% weight in the portfolio's top sector (Technology, 22.8%) and returned 2.39% over the 3-month window.

watch.text: Board meeting and conference call scheduled for October 28, 2026 to review Q2 and half-year FY27 results.
Turnaround in profitability metrics at 99acres required for future earnings upgrades.

holdings.name: Persistent Systems Ltd

what_changed.text: Persistent Systems approved raising up to ₹8,000 crore via NCDs and ₹1,000 crore via commercial paper to finance the acquisition of Nagarro SE.
September 2026 net profit fell sequentially to ₹352 crore from ₹483 crore in June 2026, with operating margin declining to 14%.
The company explored a potential QIP of up to $450 million for Nagarro acquisition financing.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 3.44% of the fund, Persistent gained 9.66% over 3 months, contributing an estimated +0.332% despite recent margin compression.

watch.text: Issuance and pricing of the ₹8,000 crore bond program and potential $450 million QIP for the Nagarro SE transaction.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO for three years starting January 1, 2027.
Provisional Q2 FY27 figures showed net advances of ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits of ₹6,51,491 crore.
The bank filed outstanding debt securities totaling ₹4,695 crore as of September 30, 2026.

expected.text: Nomura projected 17% core PPOP growth for private banks including Kotak in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.41% fund weight, Kotak gained 15.77% over 3 months, providing an estimated +0.538% positive contribution that counterbalanced weakness in ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank.

watch.text: Approval of unaudited Q2 results and earnings call scheduled for October 24, 2026.
Leadership handover to Anup Kumar Saha taking effect on January 1, 2027.

portfolio.statement: UTI Flexi Cap Fund declined -2.66% over 3 months, as sharp pullbacks across core Financials and Consumer Discretionary names outweighed strong gains in Midcap IT and Quick Commerce.
interp: The fund's heavy 22.5% Financials exposure acted as the primary performance drag, with Bajaj Finance (-10.02%), HDFC Bank (-8.44%), and ICICI Bank (-5.42%) subtracting a combined 1.26% estimated contribution.
Technology holdings (22.8% allocation) provided strong positive divergence, driven by rallies in Coforge (+27.7%), Zomato (+11.59%), and Persistent Systems (+9.66%).
portfolio.line: Technology outperformance cushioned heavy losses concentrated in private banks, NBFC lending, and consumer manufacturing.

drivers.text: Coforge gained 27.70% on AI framework rollouts and center expansions, delivering a +1.044% portfolio contribution.
Dixon Technologies retreated -17.06%, costing -0.616% in estimated portfolio contribution despite forming a new telecom optical JV.
Bajaj Finance fell -10.02% (contribution of -0.554%) amid changes in its gold loan portfolio, despite reporting 29% profit growth in Q2.

themes.title: Digital Platform Competition & Scrutiny
themes.text: Quick commerce and consumer delivery platforms are encountering rising operational scrutiny alongside new retail competitors.

themes.title: Banking Margin Squeeze & Deposit Mix
themes.text: Lenders face margin compression and shifting liability structures, seen in ICICI Bank's falling CASA ratio and brokerage flags on HDFC Bank.

themes.title: Inorganic IT Expansion & AI Deployments
themes.text: Enterprise IT holdings are pursuing debt-funded overseas acquisitions and expanding specialized AI workforce delivery.

macro.why: ICICI Bank's CASA ratio dropped 340 bps to 36.1% due to FCNR surges, while brokerages cut HDFC Bank price targets on lending margin pressure.
Dixon Technologies is expanding local components manufacturing through JVs with Gemtek for optical transceivers and Aviat IP agreements.

priced_in.text: ICICI Bank's core operating profitability is well-recognized, with Goldman Sachs and Emkay maintaining bullish price targets despite post-earnings consolidation.
Titan's consistent store growth (adding 78 stores in Q2 to reach 3,758) and 25% consumer business growth are largely factored in after a 20.39% 1-year gain.

could_change.title: Persistent Systems Leverage from Nagarro Buyout
could_change.text: The plan to issue up to ₹8,000 crore in NCDs, ₹1,000 crore in CPs, and a possible $450 million QIP could reshape balance sheet debt and capital dilution.

could_change.title: Food Delivery Market Contestation
could_change.text: Flipkart's launch of 'Eat-in by Minutes' threatens to alter market share dynamics for food delivery incumbents like Zomato.

portfolio.risk_note: With 44.3% in its top 10 holdings and over 45% concentrated across Financials and Technology alone, UTI Flexi Cap Fund remains highly vulnerable to banking margin compression and enterprise IT balance sheet strain.
